videos.title: Senco Gold reports record festive retail sales of over ₹2,426 crore

beats.say: Senco Gold just had its best festive season ever, with over 2,426 crore rupees in retail sales.

beats.title: In just *41 days*
beats.say: That came in a 41-day window, from 1 Oct to 11 Nov.

beats.title: Company *update*
beats.say: The jeweller shared the figure in an update reported by Business Standard.

scene.text: Record festive retail NSV of over ₹2,426 crore

videos.description: Senco Gold says it recorded its highest-ever retail net sales value of over ₹2,426 crore in the 41-day festive period from 1 October to 11 November 2026, as reported by Business Standard.
videos.caption: Senco Gold reports record festive retail sales of over ₹2,426 crore for 1 Oct to 11 Nov 2026 (Business Standard).

videos.title: Kaynes Technology Q2 FY27: net profit ₹39.8 crore vs ₹115.7 crore a year ago

beats.say: Kaynes Technology's quarterly profit fell to 39.8 crore rupees.

beats.title: A year *ago*
beats.say: A year ago, the same quarter made 115.7 crore.

beats.title: Shares *slipped*
beats.say: Business Standard says the shares fell over two sessions after the results.

scene.text: Kaynes shares fell over two sessions after its results

videos.description: Kaynes Technology reported a consolidated net profit of ₹39.8 crore for Q2 FY27, compared with ₹115.7 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous year, per Business Standard.
videos.caption: Kaynes Technology Q2 FY27 consolidated net profit: ₹39.8 crore vs ₹115.7 crore a year earlier (Business Standard).
